Sketch accuracy characterization

2026-11-05T22:57:08 · asap_sketchlib 0.4.0 (git a05b35c) · sketch-bench 68f6514 · 28 sketches, 84 configs · up to 1024 trials per point · N = 256 … 1,048,576 · ran on local, Intel(R) Xeon(R) CPU E5-2660 v2 @ 2.20GHz, 40 cores

Each trial runs one sketch over a fresh stream and records one error value. Each card draws one sketch at up to three configs that differ in one parameter, one color each. At each N a config's shaded area holds the share of trials its theory speaks about (for example 95% when δ = 5%; 95% where there is no theory), and its solid line is the median. Dashed lines are asap_sketchlib's own theoretical error (SketchAnalytics::theoretical_error), asked at each N: each shaded area should stay inside its own dashed lines. Hover a point for every config's quantiles.

Merged sketches

Each card takes one config of a sketch and runs the same trials again with sketch-bench's merge: each trial's stream cut into 2 or 8 contiguous shards, one sketch per shard, merged into one and scored against the whole stream; one sketch is the same trials unmerged. A sketch that merges exactly gives the unmerged error in every trial; the legend and the hover say how often that held. The dashed lines are the unmerged sketch's bound, which a merged sketch should keep.
